model.name: Plain file upload via the drop area succeeds (0.8.175 REGRESSION: recognition works then upload dies) — all uploads
model.description: Tron 0.8.175 (via PO): dropping a file on the DROP AREA — dnd debug shows the png recognized as image/png then Upload FAILED, while folder-add in the same room works. Scope = ALL uploads (not a folder case). A REGRESSION from our deploy = US breaking something, NOT a missing capability. User terms: dropping a file on the drop area uploads it and the file lands in the room. NOTE (PO): distinct from R40.86 (folders-as-drop-targets feature) — do NOT conflate; this is the regression, that is the capability.
